messages:
Alex Chen: Quick idea — can we pilot a short remediation sprint model for postmortem actions? thinking 1-week "sprintlet" per incident to reduce drift and clarify owners.
Maria Gomez: I like sprintlets. shorter timeboxes make it easier to track. how do you see handoffs working if owners are busy? :thinking_face:
Ryan Patel: +1. suggest pairing with a weekly pulse where owners confirm status (Tues) and a final close (Fri). tiny doc updates after each sprintlet.
Samira Khan: we should also capture recurrence patterns in the action card so we don't just reopen same fixes. maybe a root-cause tag and recurrence flag in the ticket.
Alex Chen: Agreed. proposed minimum process: 1) create PMR action ticket with fields: owner, due-date (1 week), recurrence-risk (low/med/high), mitigation-step, rollback plan, linked incident id. 2) weekly pulse check (Tue) 3) final verification + close (Fri).
Jordan Lee: can you paste a tiny template? easier to roll out.
Alex Chen: sure — paste below:
```
Action Item Template — sprintlet
- Incident ID: <INC-####>
- Owner: <name>
- Due date: <YYYY-MM-DD> (1 week)
- Priority: P1/P2/P3
- Recurrence risk: low/med/high
- Short summary: one-line
- Steps to implement: bullet list
- Validation steps: how we confirm it's fixed
- Rollback plan: if needed
- Post-close monitoring: duration and metrics
- Notes / follow-ups: links to runbooks / PRs
```
Maria Gomez: love that. add: 'verification owner' separate from implementation owner for better checks.
Alex Chen: done — will add as field. Also propose labeling tickets with "pmr-sprintlet" and weekly dashboard.
oncall-bot: New label suggestion "pmr-sprintlet" queued. Dashboards: create widget for open sprintlets, grouped by owner.
Ryan Patel: on rotation: recommend incident-commander rotation stays weekly, but have a separate remediation owner rotation every sprintlet so on-call IC isn't overloaded.
Samira Khan: that split makes sense. IC focuses on current incident handling; remediation owners do the longer fixes.
Jordan Lee: operational nit: require owners to update ticket with a 1-line status in JIRA before the Tue pulse. else automation pings them.
Maria Gomez: +1. automation suggestions? slack poke or email?
Alex Chen: Slack poke to owner + 1 to #eng-oncall. If no update by Wed noon, escalation to the team's manager.
Samira Khan: for recurring incidents, add a quarterly review if the 'recurrence risk' is high — not just close and forget.
Ryan Patel: rollout plan? small pilot for two months with 3 teams (infra, runtime, platform). measure: % actions closed within 1 week, recurrence rate at 30/60/90 days, owner update compliance.
Alex Chen: I'll draft a short playbook and pilot signup form. Who can own pilot coordination?
Maria Gomez: I can coordinate with infra and runtime. Jordan can get platform.
Jordan Lee: yep, I'll handle platform side.
Alex Chen: Great. I'll post a one-pager + sample dashboard by EOD tomorrow. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
